title: Contact
description: Have a project in mind or an opportunity to share? Let's connect.
helper: Send your message directly from this form. All fields are required.

feedback.success: Your message has been accepted by the email service. Thank you for getting in touch.
feedback.validation: Please check the highlighted fields and try again.
feedback.network: The connection was interrupted. Your message is preserved; retry the same message to check its status safely.
feedback.timeout: We couldn't confirm the result in time. Your message may have been sent. Retry the unchanged message to check its status.
feedback.uncertain: The email service did not confirm delivery. Your message may have been sent. Please wait before sending another message.
feedback.pending: This message is still being processed. Please wait a moment, then retry without changing it.
feedback.rateLimited: Too many requests. Please wait 10 minutes before trying again.
feedback.unavailable: Sending is temporarily unavailable. Your message is preserved. Please try again later.
